DESCRIPTION: Air raid shelter, built 1940, on a rectangular plan.  Set in landscaped grounds shared with Park House.

Archival Description [Demolished 2013]: Façade, erected 1918-9, with roundel-detailed panelled pilasters on chamfered plinths supporting ogee-detailed cornice on embossed frieze on ogee-detailed stringcourse.  Quay fronted with concrete footpath to front.

Archival Description [Demolished 2018]: Section of part creeper- or ivy-covered estate wall, extant 1840, with rubble stone soldier course coping.  Road fronted at perimeter of grounds of Rockland House.

Artificial harbour, completed 1824, on a crescent-shaped plan with granite ashlar battered walls having cut-granite coping.  Set opening off Wexford Harbour.
Ballast bank, built 1831, on a bowed rectangular plan.  Repaired, 1850.  Now disused.  Set in Wexford Harbour.

Boundary wall, installed 1858, with pair of cruciform-detailed cut-granite octagonal piers on granite ashlar plinths having cast-iron finial-topped cut-granite polygonal capping framing oak leaf-detailed cast-iron railings.  Street fronted.
